intro: The Ruins of Constellas are the shattered remnants of an ancient night elf settlement in Felwood, nestled near the roots of Mount Hyjal. Today, the once-sacred grounds are overrun by the Jadefire satyrs, who have violently profaned the settlement's moonwell with demonic fel magic.

p: The classical stone arches and crumbling plazas of Constellas reveal that this was once an idyllic night elven community. During the Third War, the Burning Legion's march through Felwood shattered the haven, leaving it exposed to lingering demonic corruption. Now, the foul Jadefire satyrs hold dominion over the stones. Led by Xavathras, they actively tend to a defiled moonwell, transforming pure waters into a font of noxious fel power on behalf of their master, Lord Xavaric.

The defilement of Constellas has provoked active resistance from Kalimdor's defenders. Druidic Emerald Bearkin battle the satyrs throughout the ruins in an attempt to reclaim the forest, while night elven investigators observe from a nearby camp to the southeast. To protect their foul rituals and prevent intruders from reaching Xavathras, the satyrs have sealed the deeper pathways into the ruins behind an impenetrable wall of magical fire.
